question: Which one of the following is not an example of simple harmonic motion?

choices.A: The motion of the Moon around the Earth as observed from Mars.
choices.B: The ripples produced when a stone is dropped into a tank of water.

choices.D: The motion of a ball bouncing on the floor.

question: Which of the following systems has an overall entropy closest to zero?

choices.C: The evaporation of ether at room temperature.
choices.D: An object in free fall when it has reached terminal velocity.
